actions.name: AcceptSharedDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to accept a directory sharing request that was sent from the directory owner account

actions.name: AddIpRoutes
actions.description: Grants permission to add a CIDR address block to correctly route traffic to and from your Microsoft AD on Amazon Web Services

actions.name: AddRegion
actions.description: Grants permission to add two domain controllers in the specified Region for the specified directory

actions.name: AddTagsToResource
actions.description: Grants permission to add or overwrite one or more tags for the specified Amazon Directory Services directory

actions.name: CancelSchemaExtension
actions.description: Grants permission to cancel an in-progress schema extension to a Microsoft AD directory

actions.name: ConnectDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to create an AD Connector to connect to an on-premises directory

actions.name: CreateAlias
actions.description: Grants permission to create an alias for a directory and assigns the alias to the directory

actions.name: CreateComputer
actions.description: Grants permission to create a computer account in the specified directory, and joins the computer to the directory

actions.name: CreateConditionalForwarder
actions.description: Grants permission to create a conditional forwarder associated with your AWS directory

actions.name: CreateDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to create a Simple AD directory

actions.name: CreateHybridAD
actions.description: Grants permission to create a Hybrid Managed AD directory

actions.name: CreateLogSubscription

actions.name: CreateMicrosoftAD
actions.description: Grants permission to create a Microsoft AD in the AWS cloud

actions.name: CreateSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to create a snapshot of a Simple AD or Microsoft AD directory in the AWS cloud

actions.name: CreateTrust
actions.description: Grants permission to initiate the creation of the AWS side of a trust relationship between a Microsoft AD in the AWS cloud and an external domain

actions.name: DeleteADAssessment
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a directory assessment

actions.name: DeleteConditionalForwarder
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a conditional forwarder that has been set up for your AWS directory

actions.name: DeleteDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to delete an AWS Directory Service directory

actions.name: DeleteLogSubscription
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified log subscription

actions.name: DeleteSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a directory snapshot

actions.name: DeleteTrust
actions.description: Grants permission to delete an existing trust relationship between your Microsoft AD in the AWS cloud and an external domain

actions.name: DeregisterCertificate
actions.description: Grants permission to delete from the system the certificate that was registered for a secured LDAP connection

actions.name: DeregisterEventTopic
actions.description: Grants permission to remove the specified directory as a publisher to the specified SNS topic

actions.name: DescribeADAssessment
actions.description: Grants permission to describe a directory assessment

actions.name: DescribeCAEnrollmentPolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the ca enrollment status of a specified directory

actions.name: DescribeCertificate
actions.description: Grants permission to display information about the certificate registered for a secured LDAP connection

actions.name: DescribeClientAuthenticationSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve information about the type of client authentication for the specified directory, if the type is specified. If no type is specified, information about all client authentication types that are supported for the specified directory is retrieved. Currently, only SmartCard is supported

actions.name: DescribeConditionalForwarders
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain information about the conditional forwarders for this account

actions.name: DescribeDirectories
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain information about the directories that belong to this account

actions.name: DescribeDirectoryDataAccess
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the Directory Service Data API status for the specified directory

actions.name: DescribeDomainControllers
actions.description: Grants permission to provide information about any domain controllers in your directory

actions.name: DescribeEventTopics
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain information about which SNS topics receive status messages from the specified directory

actions.name: DescribeHybridADUpdate
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the updates of a specified hybrid directory

actions.name: DescribeLDAPSSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the status of LDAP security for the specified directory

actions.name: DescribeRegions
actions.description: Grants permission to provide information about the Regions that are configured for multi-Region replication

actions.name: DescribeSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve information about the configurable settings for the specified directory

actions.name: DescribeSharedDirectories
actions.description: Grants permission to return the shared directories in your account

actions.name: DescribeSnapshots
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain information about the directory snapshots that belong to this account

actions.name: DescribeTrusts
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain information about the trust relationships for this account

actions.name: DescribeUpdateDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to describe the updates of a directory for a particular update type

actions.name: DisableCAEnrollmentPolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to disable the ca enrollment of a specified directory

actions.description: Grants permission to disable alternative client authentication methods for the specified directory

actions.name: DisableDirectoryDataAccess
actions.description: Grants permission to disable the Directory Service Data API for the specified directory

actions.name: DisableLDAPS
actions.description: Grants permission to deactivate LDAP secure calls for the specified directory

actions.name: DisableRadius
actions.description: Grants permission to disable multi-factor authentication (MFA) with the Remote Authentication Dial In User Service (RADIUS) server for an AD Connector directory

actions.name: DisableSso
actions.description: Grants permission to disable single-sign on for a directory

actions.name: EnableCAEnrollmentPolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to enable the ca enrollment of a specified directory

actions.name: EnableClientAuthentication
actions.description: Grants permission to enable alternative client authentication methods for the specified directory

actions.name: EnableDirectoryDataAccess
actions.description: Grants permission to enable the Directory Service Data API for the specified directory

actions.name: EnableLDAPS
actions.description: Grants permission to activate the switch for the specific directory to always use LDAP secure calls

actions.name: EnableRadius
actions.description: Grants permission to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) with the Remote Authentication Dial In User Service (RADIUS) server for an AD Connector directory

actions.description: Grants permission to enable single-sign on for a directory

actions.name: GetDirectoryLimits
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain directory limit information for the current region

actions.name: GetSnapshotLimits
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain the manual snapshot limits for a directory

actions.name: ListADAssessments
actions.description: Grants permission to list directory assessments

actions.name: ListCertificates
actions.description: Grants permission to list all the certificates registered for a secured LDAP connection, for the specified directory

actions.name: ListIpRoutes
actions.description: Grants permission to list the address blocks that you have added to a directory

actions.name: ListLogSubscriptions
actions.description: Grants permission to list the active log subscriptions for the AWS account

actions.name: ListSchemaExtensions
actions.description: Grants permission to list all schema extensions applied to a Microsoft AD Directory

actions.name: ListTagsForResource
actions.description: Grants permission to list all tags on an Amazon Directory Services directory

actions.name: RegisterCertificate
actions.description: Grants permission to register a certificate for secured LDAP connection

actions.name: RegisterEventTopic
actions.description: Grants permission to associate a directory with an SNS topic

actions.name: RejectSharedDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to reject a directory sharing request that was sent from the directory owner account

actions.name: RemoveIpRoutes
actions.description: Grants permission to remove IP address blocks from a directory

actions.description: Grants permission to stop all replication and removes the domain controllers from the specified Region. You cannot remove the primary Region with this operation

actions.name: RemoveTagsFromResource
actions.description: Grants permission to remove tags from an Amazon Directory Services directory

actions.name: ResetUserPassword
actions.description: Grants permission to reset the password for any user in your AWS Managed Microsoft AD or Simple AD directory

actions.name: RestoreFromSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to restore a directory using an existing directory snapshot

actions.description: Grants permission to share a specified directory in your AWS account (directory owner) with another AWS account (directory consumer). With this operation you can use your directory from any AWS account and from any Amazon VPC within an AWS Region

actions.name: StartADAssessment
actions.description: Grants permission to start a directory assessment

actions.name: StartSchemaExtension
actions.description: Grants permission to apply a schema extension to a Microsoft AD directory

actions.name: UnshareDirectory
actions.description: Grants permission to stop the directory sharing between the directory owner and consumer accounts

actions.name: UpdateConditionalForwarder
actions.description: Grants permission to update a conditional forwarder that has been set up for your AWS directory

actions.name: UpdateDirectorySetup
actions.description: Grants permission to update the directory for a particular update type

actions.name: UpdateHybridAD
actions.description: Grants permission to update configurations for a specified hybrid directory

actions.name: UpdateNumberOfDomainControllers
actions.description: Grants permission to add or remove domain controllers to or from the directory. Based on the difference between current value and new value (provided through this API call), domain controllers will be added or removed. It may take up to 45 minutes for any new domain controllers to become fully active once the requested number of domain controllers is updated. During this time, you cannot make another update request

actions.name: UpdateRadius
actions.description: Grants permission to update the Remote Authentication Dial In User Service (RADIUS) server information for an AD Connector directory

actions.name: UpdateSettings
actions.description: Grants permission to update the configurable settings for the specified directory

actions.name: UpdateTrust
actions.description: Grants permission to update the trust that has been set up between your AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory and an on-premises Active Directory

actions.name: VerifyTrust
actions.description: Grants permission to verify a trust relationship between your Microsoft AD in the AWS cloud and an external domain

actions.name: AccessDSData
actions.description: Grants permission to access directory data using the Directory Service Data API

actions.name: AuthorizeApplication

actions.name: CheckAlias
actions.description: Grants permission to verify that the alias is available for use

actions.name: DisableRoleAccess

actions.name: EnableRoleAccess
actions.description: Grants permission to enable AWS Management Console access for identity in your AWS Directory

actions.name: GetAuthorizedApplicationDetails
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the details of the authorized applications on a directory

actions.name: ListAuthorizedApplications
actions.description: Grants permission to obtain the AWS applications authorized for a directory
